brief: The 5-step sleep ritual that fixed my insomnia.

slots.headline: The Sleep Fix?
slots.subtitle: The evening routine that finally worked.

slots.title: Cut Caffeine Early
slots.body: Stop caffeine after 2 PM. It lingers in your system longer than you think, blocking adenosine.

slots.title: Digital Sunset Rule
slots.body: No screens one hour before bed. Blue light suppresses melatonin and keeps your brain wired.

slots.title: Cool Your Room Down
slots.body: Set thermostat to 65 degrees. A cooler core tells your body it's time to hibernate.

slots.title: Try Box Breathing
slots.body: Inhale four counts, hold, exhale, hold. Repeat ten times to shift into parasympathetic mode.

slots.title: Same Time Daily
slots.body: Wake up at the same time every day. Consistency anchors your circadian rhythm better than anything.

slots.title: Wake Up Rested
slots.body: Stack these five steps for one week. Your brain will relearn how to fall asleep fast.
